description.value:
Courier of whispers, riding the dark bandwidth.

Level 3: Blackchannel (BBTTCC)

During Courtly Intrigue/Infiltration, spend 1 Intrigue OP to open a relay: bonus‑action short messages along your route for 10 minutes.

Level 3: Packet Slip

Disengage lets you Hide if lightly obscured.

Level 6: Quiet Handoff

Passing an item grants the ally +PB to next Sleight or Stealth within 1 minute.

Level 10: Countertrace

Reaction: against magical surveillance, force caster check vs your DC; on fail, you’re invisible to that effect for 1 minute (PB/long).

Level 14: Courier’s Parity

1/long rest duplicate a Tiny item for 1 hour (mundane indistinguishable).
